title: The localized tensor comparison predicate
statement: Let R,A,B,C be commutative rings in a universe u, A and B commutative R-algebras, and C an algebra over E=A tensor_R B. Use the derived categories of R-, A- and B-modules. Let Q be a cochain complex of A-modules, N a cochain complex of C-modules, F termwise scalar extension along A to E to C, and t:F(Q) to N a chain map. Define P(X), for X in D(A), by requiring the following for every cochain complex U of A-modules with a derived isomorphism Q_A(U) isomorphic to X: if tensoring any acyclic A-complex with U is acyclic, then for every base-derived tensor cohomology model mU of U tensor_A Q and every integer i, mU.localizedComparison_i followed by H^i(mu_F(U,Q)^(-1) followed by (F(U) tensor t)) is an isomorphism. All quantification is explicit and no comparison is assumed invertible in this definition.
